task: At the coffee machine before a client meeting, a client staff member asks if you're there for the ten o'clock meeting. Say yes and introduce yourself.
say: Are you here for the ten o'clock?
zh: 客户会议开始前，你在咖啡机旁边。一位客户员工问你是不是来参加十点的会议。说是，并介绍自己。对方说：你是来开十点那个会的吗？
example: Yes, I am. I'm {name}, from {company}. Nice to meet you.

task: In the lift at the client's office, someone sees your visitor badge and asks if you're from the IT company. Answer, introduce yourself and ask one question.
say: Are you from the IT company?
zh: 在客户办公楼的电梯里，有人看到你的访客证，问你是不是那家 IT 公司的。回答，介绍自己，再问一个问题。对方说：你是那家 IT 公司的吗？
example: Yes, that's us! I'm {name}, from {company}. Are you coming to the meeting too?

task: You phone a client's office. Reception answers. Introduce yourself and ask to speak to Mike about tomorrow's meeting.
say: Good morning, reception.
zh: 你给客户的办公室打电话，前台接了。介绍自己，并说要找 Mike 谈明天开会的事。对方说：早上好，这里是前台。
example: Hi, it's {name} from {company}. Could I speak to Mike, please? It's about tomorrow's meeting.

task: You meet a client you met at last month's kick-off, but you've forgotten their name. Greet them, ask simply, and remind them of yours.
say: Hi again! Good to see you.
zh: 你遇到上个月启动会上见过的一位客户，但忘了对方的名字。打个招呼，简单地问一下，并提醒对方你的名字。对方说：又见面了！很高兴见到你。
example: Hi, good to see you too! Sorry, remind me of your name? I'm {name}, we met at the kick-off last month.

task: A client looks at the colleague who came with you. It's Aroha, one of your developers, and she'll build the client's new app with you. Introduce her in one or two sentences.
say: And who's this?
zh: 客户看向和你一起来的同事。她是 Aroha，你们的开发人员之一，会和你一起为客户开发新应用。用一两句话介绍她。对方说：这位是？
example: This is Aroha, one of our developers. She'll be building the new app with me.

task: Introduce the client's IT manager, Sarah, to your colleague Raj, a network engineer who'll do their network upgrade. Give each one a line.
say: Hi! Who've you brought along today?
zh: 把客户的 IT 经理 Sarah 介绍给你的同事 Raj，他是网络工程师，将负责他们的网络升级。给两个人各介绍一句。对方说：你好！今天带谁来了？
example: Sarah, this is Raj, one of our network engineers. He'll be doing your network upgrade. Raj, Sarah runs IT here, so she's the one to go to for anything on site.

task: A client asks what your company does. Use this: it does cloud hosting and IT support for medium-sized businesses, and has about 80 staff. Answer in two sentences.
say: Sorry, I don't actually know much about your company. What do you do?
zh: 客户问你们公司是做什么的。用这些信息：公司为中型企业提供云托管和 IT 支持，大约有 80 名员工。用两句话回答。对方说：不好意思，我其实不太了解你们公司。你们是做什么的？
example: No worries. {company} does cloud hosting and IT support for medium-sized businesses. There are about 80 of us, so we're big enough to cover everything, but small enough that you'll know who you're dealing with.

task: Your mobile rings. It's a client you haven't spoken to before, asking if you're the person handling their email migration. Introduce yourself and offer help.
say: Hi, is that the person looking after our email migration?
zh: 你的手机响了，是一位以前没联系过的客户，问你是不是负责他们邮件迁移的人。介绍自己，并问能帮什么忙。对方说：你好，请问是负责我们邮件迁移的那位吗？
example: Yes, speaking. It's {name} from {company}. I'm looking after your email migration. How can I help?

task: It's your first day in your company's data team, after moving over from the support team. Your new team lead asks you to say hello at the team meeting.
say: Everyone, we've got a new team member today. Want to say hi?
zh: 你从支持团队调到公司的数据团队，今天是第一天。新组长请你在团队会议上打个招呼。对方说：各位，今天我们有新同事加入。你来打个招呼？
example: Hi everyone, I'm {name}. I've just moved over from the support team, so I already know a lot of our clients. I'm really excited to be on the data side. Be patient with my questions!

task: At an industry networking evening, you're standing with your client Mike. Someone new asks what you do. You help businesses move to the cloud. Answer in about 10 seconds.
say: And what do you do?
zh: 在一个行业交流晚会上，你和客户 Mike 站在一起。一位新认识的人问你做什么。你帮企业把系统迁到云上。用大约 10 秒回答。对方说：那你是做什么的？
example: I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. I help businesses move their systems to the cloud. In fact, I'm working with Mike's team at the moment.

task: On a one-day project management course, the trainer asks for your name, where you work and one thing you want from today: getting better at running meetings.
say: Let's go round. Name, where you work, and one thing you want from today.
zh: 在一天的项目管理课程上，培训师请大家说名字、在哪里工作，以及今天想学到的一件事：更好地主持会议。对方说：我们轮一圈。名字、在哪工作、今天想学到什么。
example: Hi, I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. One thing I want from today is to get better at running meetings, especially keeping them on time.

task: You see a client you met once, back in March at a security workshop. They look unsure. Re-introduce yourself and remind them where you met.
say: Hi... sorry, have we met?
zh: 你遇到一位只在三月份的安全研讨会上见过一次的客户。对方看起来不太确定。重新介绍自己，并提醒对方你们在哪儿见过。对方说：你好……不好意思，我们见过吗？
example: We have, but it was a while ago! I'm {name}, from {company}. We met at the security workshop back in March. How's everything going?

task: Open a pre-sales meeting by introducing your company in three sentences. Use: New Zealand-owned, about 15 years in business, focused on Microsoft cloud and data, clients mostly in health and local government.
say: Maybe you could start by telling us a bit about your company?
zh: 在售前会议开始时，用三句话介绍你们公司。用这些信息：新西兰本土公司，成立大约 15 年，专注微软云和数据，客户主要在医疗和地方政府。对方说：要不你先介绍一下你们公司？
example: Sure. {company} is a New Zealand-owned IT company, and we've been around for about 15 years. We focus on Microsoft cloud and data. Most of our clients are in health and local government, so we're used to working where security and reliability really matter.

task: Before a project starts, you record a short video for the client's staff. Say your name and role, that you'll be setting up their new laptops, and that you'll be on site next Tuesday.
zh: 项目开始前，你给客户员工录一段短视频。说出你的名字和职位，说明你将为他们配置新笔记本电脑，并且下周二会到现场。
example: Hi everyone, I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. I'll be setting up your new laptops, and I'll be on site next Tuesday. Come and say hi, and bring any questions. See you then!

task: Introduce your colleague Raj to the client. He's a security specialist with about ten years' experience, and he'll run their penetration test. Make him sound good.
say: Who's this with you today?
zh: 把同事 Raj 介绍给客户。他是安全专家，大约有十年经验，将负责他们的渗透测试。把他介绍得出色一点。对方说：今天和你一起来的这位是？
example: This is Raj, our security specialist. He's got about ten years' experience, and he'll be running your penetration test. If anyone can find a weak spot, it's Raj.

task: You're about to demo the new sales dashboard to the client's sales team. Introduce yourself and say what they'll see in the next 15 minutes: finding their numbers, filtering by region and exporting a report.
say: Okay, the floor is yours.
zh: 你要给客户的销售团队演示新的销售仪表盘。介绍自己，并说明接下来 15 分钟他们会看到什么：查看自己的数据、按地区筛选、导出报表。对方说：好，交给你了。
example: Thanks. Hi everyone, I'm {name} from {company}. Over the next 15 minutes I'll show you the new sales dashboard: where to find your numbers, how to filter by region, and how to export a report. Questions at the end, please.

task: You're a guest at a Toastmasters club. The chair asks guests to introduce themselves. You work in IT and want to feel more confident speaking in client meetings.
say: Would any of our guests like to introduce themselves?
zh: 你作为嘉宾参加 Toastmasters 俱乐部的活动。主持人请嘉宾自我介绍。你在 IT 行业工作，想在客户会议上说话更有自信。对方说：有哪位嘉宾想介绍一下自己吗？
example: Hi everyone, I'm {name}, and I work in IT at {company}. A big part of my job is talking to clients, and I want to feel more confident doing it. So, here I am!

task: At a cloud user group meetup, the host asks newcomers for their name, company and what they're working on: a cloud migration for a logistics company. Don't name the client.
say: We've got a few new faces. Tell us who you are and what you're working on.
zh: 在一个云计算用户交流会上，主持人请新人说名字、公司和正在做的项目：为一家物流公司做云迁移。不要说出客户的名字。对方说：今天有几位新面孔。介绍一下你是谁、在做什么项目。
example: Hi all, I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. At the moment I'm working on a cloud migration for a logistics company. It's a big one, so I'm keen to hear how others handle the tricky bits.

task: You're on a phone call with a client team, no video. Introduce yourself and say that your colleague Aroha, the project manager, is on the line too. Then hand over to her.
say: Who have we got on the line from your side?
zh: 你和客户团队打电话，没有视频。介绍自己，并说明项目经理 Aroha 也在线，然后让她说话。对方说：你们那边有谁在线？
example: Hi, it's {name} here, {role} at {company}. I've also got Aroha with me, our project manager. Aroha, do you want to say hello?

task: At your company's monthly all-hands meeting, new starters introduce themselves. Say your name, your team (the cloud team) and a fun fact: you make great dumplings.
say: And now let's hear from our new starters!
zh: 公司每月的全员大会上，新员工要做自我介绍。说出你的名字、团队（云团队）和一个有趣的事实：你包饺子很拿手。对方说：现在请新同事们来介绍一下！
example: Hi everyone, I'm {name}, and I've just joined the cloud team. Fun fact: I make really good dumplings. So if you ever need a favour from me, you know what to bring!

task: Your manager, Sarah, Head of Delivery, comes to a client meeting for the first time. Introduce her to the client and say why she's there: to hear their feedback first-hand.
say: Oh, hello. I don't think we've met.
zh: 你的经理 Sarah（交付主管）第一次来参加客户会议。把她介绍给客户，并说明她来的目的：直接听取他们的反馈。对方说：哦，你好。我们好像没见过。
example: Let me introduce you. This is Sarah, our Head of Delivery. She looks after all our projects, and I report to her. She's here today to hear your feedback first-hand.

task: A retail client is worried about their website crashing on Black Friday. Introduce your company and link it to their worry. Use: your company does cloud hosting with 24/7 monitoring.
say: Our big fear is the website falling over on Black Friday.
zh: 一家零售客户担心他们的网站在黑色星期五崩溃。介绍你们公司，并和他们的担心联系起来。用这些信息：公司提供云托管和 24 小时监控。对方说：我们最怕的就是网站在黑色星期五崩掉。
example: That's exactly the kind of thing we help with. {company} does cloud hosting with 24/7 monitoring, so your site can grow with the traffic. And if anything starts to slow down, we'll see it before your customers do.

task: Aroha leads the client's data team. Your colleague Mike built a very similar dashboard for another client last year. Introduce them to each other and say why they should talk.
say: Is there anyone I should talk to about our dashboard?
zh: Aroha 是客户数据团队的负责人。你的同事 Mike 去年为另一个客户做过一个非常类似的仪表盘。把他们互相介绍一下，并说明他们为什么应该聊聊。对方说：关于我们的仪表盘，我应该找谁聊聊？
example: Actually, yes. Aroha, this is Mike. He built a really similar dashboard for one of our other clients last year. Mike, Aroha leads the data team here. I think a half-hour chat would save you both a lot of time.

task: You're opening a 30-minute online demo for 40 client staff. Introduce yourself, say how long it will take, and explain how questions work: type them in the chat, and you'll answer at the end.
zh: 你要开始一场有 40 位客户员工参加、30 分钟的线上演示。介绍自己，说明需要多长时间，并说明提问方式：把问题打在聊天框里，你最后统一回答。
example: Hi everyone, and thanks for joining. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. Over the next 30 minutes I'll take you through the new system. If you've got questions, pop them in the chat as you go, and I'll answer them all at the end.

task: At a networking event, a client you worked with introduces you to a friend. You did the client's email migration together. Say hello, introduce yourself, and ask the friend a question.
say: Have you two met? This is the person who sorted out our email migration.
zh: 在一个交流活动上，你合作过的一位客户把你介绍给他的朋友。你们一起完成了客户的邮件迁移。打招呼，介绍自己，再问对方的朋友一个问题。对方说：你们俩见过吗？就是这位帮我们搞定了邮件迁移。
example: Hi, nice to meet you. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. Yes, we did the email migration together, and to be fair, they made it easy for us. What line of work are you in?

task: You phone a client's new IT manager, Raj, for the first time. You're the technical contact for their account. Introduce yourself, welcome him, and ask for a short meeting.
say: Hello, Raj speaking.
zh: 你第一次给客户新上任的 IT 经理 Raj 打电话。你是他们账户的技术联系人。介绍自己，欢迎他上任，并约一个简短的会面。对方说：你好，我是 Raj。
example: Hi Raj, it's {name} from {company}. I'm the technical contact for your account. I heard you've just started, so welcome! I'd love to grab half an hour sometime to introduce myself properly. Would next week work?

task: You're at a client's warehouse for a safety induction before two weeks of installing network equipment there. The trainer asks everyone to say who they are and why they're on site.
say: Can everyone say who they are and why they're on site?
zh: 你在客户的仓库参加安全培训，之后要在那里安装两周的网络设备。培训师请每个人说自己是谁、为什么来现场。对方说：请每个人说一下你是谁、为什么来现场？
example: Hi, I'm {name}, from {company}. I'll be here for the next two weeks installing new network equipment, so you'll see me up ladders and in the comms room. Please give me a shout if I'm ever in the way.

task: At a conference, a client greets you warmly, but you can't remember their name. Your colleague Raj has just joined your cloud team. Introduce Raj, so the client says their own name.
say: Hey, great to see you again! How've you been?
zh: 在一个会议上，一位客户热情地跟你打招呼，但你想不起对方的名字。你的同事 Raj 刚加入你们的云团队。介绍 Raj，让客户自己说出名字。对方说：嘿，又见到你了！最近怎么样？
example: Really good, thanks, and great to see you too! Oh, have you met my colleague Raj? He's just joined our cloud team.

task: You're giving a ten-minute talk at an industry meetup about three lessons from a cloud migration you worked on this year. Introduce yourself and the talk in about 20 seconds.
say: Please welcome our next speaker.
zh: 你要在一个行业交流会上做十分钟演讲，讲你今年参与的一个云迁移项目的三条经验。用大约 20 秒介绍自己和演讲内容。对方说：有请下一位演讲者。
example: Thanks, and evening, everyone. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. Tonight I'll share three lessons from a cloud migration I worked on this year, including one mistake I'll never make again. It's only ten minutes, so let's get into it.

task: At a kick-off, introduce your whole team in about 30 seconds: Aroha is the project manager, Raj the developer, Mike the tester. You're the technical lead.
say: Could you introduce your team for us?
zh: 在启动会上，用大约 30 秒介绍你的整个团队：Aroha 是项目经理，Raj 是开发人员，Mike 是测试人员，你是技术负责人。对方说：能给我们介绍一下你的团队吗？
example: Sure. I'm {name}, and I'm the technical lead. Aroha is our project manager, so she'll keep us on time and on budget. Raj is our developer, and he'll do most of the build. And Mike's our tester, so he'll make sure it all works before you see it.

task: In the lift, the client's chief executive asks if you're one of the IT people. You're working on their new payroll system, which goes live next month. Answer confidently in about 15 seconds, before the doors open.
say: Are you one of the IT people working with us?
zh: 在电梯里，客户的首席执行官问你是不是为他们服务的 IT 人员之一。你在做他们的新薪资系统，下个月上线。在电梯门打开前，用大约 15 秒自信地回答。对方说：你是为我们做 IT 的那些人之一吗？
example: Yes, I am. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. I'm working on your new payroll system. We go live next month, and so far it's looking good. Nice to meet you.

task: The client has had the same problem three times and is frustrated. Introduce your senior colleague Sarah, who is taking over the fix personally. Show you take it seriously, then hand over to her.
say: Three times now. Who's going to sort this out properly?
zh: 同样的问题客户已经遇到三次了，很不满。介绍你的资深同事 Sarah，她将亲自接手处理。表现出你很重视，然后把话交给她。对方说：已经三次了。到底谁能彻底解决？
example: I understand, and I'm sorry it's happened again. That's why I've brought Sarah in. She's our most senior engineer, and she's taking this over personally. Sarah, do you want to explain what happens next?

task: You're about to demo a system to the client, but the test system has just gone down. Introduce yourself and reset expectations: today you'll use screenshots, and the live demo will be next week.
say: Okay, we're ready when you are.
zh: 你正要给客户做系统演示，但测试系统刚刚宕机了。介绍自己，并调整大家的预期：今天用截图讲解，现场演示改到下周。对方说：好，你准备好了就开始吧。
example: Thanks, everyone. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. Bit of bad timing, I'm afraid. Our test system has just gone down, so today I'll walk you through screenshots instead, and we'll do the live demo next week. You'll still get the full picture.

task: At an industry panel, the host asks you to introduce yourself and your company in 30 seconds. Use: your company does data and AI work for farming and forestry businesses. Make it sound human, not like an advert.
say: Tell us a bit about yourself and your company.
zh: 在一个行业座谈会上，主持人请你用 30 秒介绍自己和公司。用这些信息：公司为农业和林业企业做数据和人工智能方面的工作。听起来要有人情味，不要像广告。对方说：介绍一下你自己和你们公司吧。
example: Sure. I'm {name}, and I work at {company}. We do data and AI work for farming and forestry businesses. So a lot of my week is helping people who'd rather be outdoors make better use of their data. It keeps us very practical!

task: You're calling a client about their server upgrade, but the line is bad and they keep mishearing you. Repeat your name and company clearly, say why you're calling, and offer to send an email.
say: Sorry, who did you say you were?
zh: 你打电话给客户谈服务器升级的事，但信号不好，对方一直听错。清楚地重复你的名字和公司，说明来电目的，并提出发一封邮件。对方说：不好意思，你说你是哪位？
example: Sorry, the line's not great. It's {name}, from {company}. I'm calling about your server upgrade. How about I send you a quick email, so you've got my details in writing?

task: A senior client mistakes you for your colleague Raj. Correct them kindly and introduce yourself. Raj looks after their network; you look after their backups.
say: Raj! Good to see you again.
zh: 一位客户高层把你错认成了同事 Raj。友好地纠正，并介绍自己。Raj 负责他们的网络，你负责他们的备份。对方说：Raj！又见面了。
example: Ah, close! I'm actually {name}, Raj's colleague. He looks after your network, and I look after your backups. Easy to mix us up, we're always in meetings together! Good to see you.

task: At a networking event, a potential client asks what your company does and where you fit in. Use: your company helps mid-sized businesses run their Microsoft cloud, with 24/7 support; you lead the migrations. Answer in under a minute and end with a question.
say: So what does your company do, and where do you fit in?
zh: 在一个交流活动上，一位潜在客户问你们公司做什么、你负责哪部分。用这些信息：公司帮助中型企业运营微软云，提供 24 小时支持；你负责带领迁移项目。一分钟内回答完，最后问一个问题。对方说：你们公司是做什么的？你负责哪一块？
example: {company} helps mid-sized businesses run their Microsoft cloud, with 24/7 support, so they don't need a big IT team of their own. My part is the migrations. I take companies from old servers in a cupboard to the cloud, without the drama. What about you? How are your systems set up at the moment?

task: The client has just heard a slick pitch from a bigger competitor. Now it's your turn. Introduce yourself and your company without criticising the competitor. Use: your company is smaller and local, and the same engineers stay with a client from start to finish.
say: The last company was very impressive. What makes you different?
zh: 客户刚听完一家更大的竞争对手精彩的推介，现在轮到你了。介绍自己和公司，但不要批评对手。用这些信息：你们公司规模小、是本地公司，同一批工程师从头到尾跟进一个客户。对方说：上一家公司很厉害。你们有什么不同？
example: They're a good company, no question. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. We're smaller and local, and the big difference is that the same engineers stay with you from start to finish. So the people in this room are the people who'll actually do the work.

task: You're moving to a new project. Your newer colleague Aroha will take over the client's day-to-day support, and the client looks nervous. She has worked on their system with you for six months. Introduce her and build their confidence.
say: So Aroha will be looking after us now?
zh: 你要调到新项目。资历较浅的同事 Aroha 将接手客户的日常支持，客户看起来有点担心。她已经和你一起做他们的系统六个月了。介绍她，增强客户的信心。对方说：所以以后是 Aroha 负责我们了？
example: Yes, and you're in really good hands. Aroha's been working on your system with me for the last six months, so she knows it inside out. Honestly, she's fixed a few things I couldn't. And I'm not going far. If she ever needs me, I'm only a message away.

task: You're presenting to the client's board: five directors, none of them technical. Your team spent two months reviewing their systems, and you have 20 minutes to recommend a cloud strategy. Introduce yourself and the purpose in about 30 seconds, with no jargon.
say: Thank you. Over to you.
zh: 你要向客户的董事会做汇报：五位董事，都不懂技术。你们团队花了两个月评估他们的系统，你有 20 分钟来建议一个上云策略。用大约 30 秒介绍自己和汇报目的，不用专业术语。对方说：谢谢。请开始吧。
example: Thank you, and good morning. I'm {name}, {role} at {company}. Over the last two months, our team has looked at how your systems are set up today. In the next 20 minutes, I'll share what we found and our recommendation for moving to the cloud, in plain English, including what it means for cost and risk.
